name: khairold
description: Khairold's skills. dot-plan: plan, run, gate, audit and close an unattended multi-phase agent build kept in .plan/, looping until an audit round comes back dry. agent-guides: per-folder guides, a short root guide, one place per fact, kept true by tests. codebase-audit: audit a codebase by lens before a refactor, fold the findings into axes of work, re-audit after a build until dry, or sweep for one recurring bug class. cockpit: a mod for watching a dot-plan run from a second session (/cockpit).
